title: Postman: verify connection field names in dataset and data model source API responses
description:
Before adding connection attributes to any stored proc, verify exact field names via Postman:
- GET /v2/datasets/{id}/sources — table-type source shape (looking for connectionId, connectionName, databaseName, schemaName, tableName)
- GET /v2/dataModels/{id}/sources — same for data model sources
- GET /v2/connections — list response shape (connectionId, name, type)
- GET /v2/dataModels/{id}/lineage — check if this returns connection info more directly

title: DataSetMigrateHelper_SF: add setVariable onClick handler to ECharts graph plugin
description: The ECharts plugin (Graph_DataSetMigrate repo, App.jsx) currently renders the graph but emits no selection events back to Sigma. Add client.setVariable('selectedNodeId', params.data.id) inside the ECharts onClick handler so that clicking a node drives filtering in the host Sigma workbook. Depends on V_GRAPH_FLAT.sql being available in the workbook.
close_reason: Not needed - click-to-open-URL in plugin is sufficient, setVariable not required

title: DataSetMigrateHelper_SF: build V_GRAPH_FLAT.sql view for node-click filtering
description: New SQL view needed in DataSetMigrateHelper_SF/views/ to support click-to-filter from the ECharts graph plugin. Joins every edge with full node metadata from both ends, plus a focal_node_id UNION pattern so WHERE focal_node_id = ? returns all edges touching a selected node in either direction. Columns: source_name/type/subtype/status, target_name/type/subtype/status, focal_node_id, neighbor_id/name/type/status.
close_reason: Not needed - V_GRAPH_FLAT was for setVariable filtering which is not required

title: DataSetMigrateHelper_SF: commit and validate V_NODES_DATA / V_EDGES_DATA view changes
description: Both view files have uncommitted modifications sitting in the working tree. V_EDGES_DATA.sql is staged; V_NODES_DATA.sql is unstaged. These views feed the Sigma graph plugin and need to be committed and validated before the graph filtering work can proceed.

title: DataSetMigrateHelper_SF: add sigma_artifact_grants() proc and SIGMA_ARTIFACT_GRANTS table — fetches permission grants for datasets, data models, workbooks
DataSetMigrateHelper_SF: create V_CHAIN_MEMBERS view — map each node ID to chain(s) with CHAIN_PATH and CHAIN_MIGRATION_STATUS
description:
Columns: CHAIN_ROOT_ID, CHAIN_PATH, CHAIN_MIGRATION_STATUS, NODE_ID. One row per (chain, node) combination. Used as the join table between a chain picker control and the graph node source.
Decision needed before implementation: a node can appear in multiple chains — should it appear in ALL matching chains (correct but produces multiple rows per node) or only its primary/deepest chain? This affects how the Sigma workbook filter is structured.

title: DataSetMigrateHelper_SF: create V_CHAIN_SUMMARY view — one row per chain path with CHAIN_PATH, CHAIN_DEPTH, CHAIN_MIGRATION_STATUS
description: Based on dataset_chains_pivoted.sql logic. Materialise as a view with columns: ROOT_ID, ROOT_NAME, CHAIN_PATH, CHAIN_DEPTH, CHAIN_MIGRATION_STATUS (FULLY MIGRATED / PARTIALLY MIGRATED / NOT MIGRATED). Use as a dropdown/list source in Sigma so users can pick a chain to drive graph filtering.

title: DataSetMigrateHelper_SF: enhance V_NODES_DATA with crossover columns (IS_FORK_POINT, IS_MERGE_POINT, UPSTREAM_PARENT_COUNT, DOWNSTREAM_CHILD_COUNT)
description: Add crossover analysis columns to dataset nodes in V_NODES_DATA. All four values already exist in SIGMA_DATASET_DEPENDENCIES — just not currently surfaced in the view. Enables Sigma filter controls on fork/merge points directly on the graph's node source.

title: writeback_info_sf: complete Snowflake port of populate script
description: writeback_info_sf/ is a new untracked directory marked IN DEVELOPMENT. It is a Snowflake port of the working writeback_info_dbx toolkit. The populate_sigds_workbook_map.py script needs to be completed and validated.
